summary: Phase 11.4 Admin Settings nav-visibility bug fix VERIFIED. Backend gating (6/6 pytest) and Frontend Playwright (7/7 checks) all pass. Super Admin sees nav-admin-settings and /admin/settings renders admin-settings-page with all 12 tab buttons (company, users, integrations, ai_providers, account, numbering, tax, email_templates, form_templates, bi_tokens, audit_log, backup). Estimator does NOT see nav-admin-settings and hitting /admin/settings directly renders admin-settings-forbidden with the 'available to Super Admins only' copy. Regression routes /reports/projects and /reports/compliance-forms both render data-testid='report-table' (previously reported 'Unknown report' bug is fixed). Backend: GET /api/admin/settings returns 200 for admin@ and 403 for staff@ and production@.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx visibleNav filter chain now correctly honours superAdminOnly (line 47) in addition to perm (line 48) — the reported bug fix is in place and functional.
AdminSettings.jsx cleanly returns the forbidden pane before attempting to fetch /admin/settings for non-super-admins, avoiding an unnecessary 403 request and keeping the UX clean.

AdminSettings uses LinkTiles for 6 tabs (company, users, integrations, form_templates, audit_log, bi_tokens) that navigate to existing pages — this is by design per the review note and does not affect visibility test.
Backend correctly gates /api/admin/settings and related mutation endpoints via require_super_admin (403 for both estimator and production verified).
test_credentials: admin@paneltec.com.au / Paneltec2026! (super); staff@paneltec.com.au / Staff2026! (estimator); production@paneltec.com.au / Prod2026! (production).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 11.4 regression at /app/backend/tests/test_phase11_admin_settings.py. Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://concrete-panel-app.preview.emergentagent.com pytest backend/tests/test_phase11_admin_settings.py -v. Key testids for Admin Settings: nav-admin-settings (sidebar), admin-settings-page (super admin), admin-settings-forbidden (non-super), admin-tab-{key} for each of the 12 tabs, admin-pane-{key}, admin-tabs (nav rail). /admin/settings ProtectedRoute in App.js has no permission (open) — the SuperAdmin gate is entirely inside AdminSettings.jsx via useAuth().isSuperAdmin — that's fine because backend gates the data endpoint too.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Layout.jsx's visibleNav filter had only `filter((i) => !i.perm || hasPerm(i.perm))`, so items with `superAdminOnly:true` and no `perm` key were shown to everyone. Fix (verified present in code): additional filter `.filter((i) => (i.superAdminOnly ? isSuperAdmin : true))` inserted before the perm filter. Result: nav-admin-settings visible only when isSuperAdmin===true. Confirmed via Playwright: admin sees it, estimator does not.
